QuestInfo.name: Tasty Milk 3
QuestInfo.0: Maybe Dragon Babies drink milk too. Get some milk from the Dairy Cow.
QuestInfo.1: You received milk from the #p1013105#. Will #p1013000# like milk? Give the milk to #p1013000#.
QuestInfo.2: #p1013000# really enjoyed the milk. And it seems as if #p1013000# has become a bit stronger.

0.0: #b(You ask the #p1013105# to give you some milk.)#k

yes.0: #b(The #p1013105# gives you some milk. Go feed the milk to #p1013000#.)#k

no.0: #b(You're too afraid to get closer. Come back later for the milk.)#k

1.0: I'm so hungry, I have no strength left... Master, I'm so hungry I might shrivel up and really become a lizard. What's this? Water? You want me to fill my stomach with water? If you say so, master...

yes.1: Wow, this is so good! What is this water called? Milk? Yum! I feel sooo strong now!
yes.2: Hey, it looks like you've become stronger too, master. Your HP and MP is much higher than when I first saw you.

npc.1: #b(It doesn't look like she's going to give you anymore milk. Go feed the milk to #p1013000#.)#k

item.0: Ah... I'm so hungry... I'm so hungry I think I could eat anything. Master, do you think it would be weird for a Dragon to eat dirt?

yes.0: #b(Looks as if the #p1013105# will get mad if you ask her for any more. Be careful not to lose the milk again.)#k
